node_definition.done_when: Done when a test runs a batch of five entries over fixture sections. One section's sentence ends "and the new test" and its done-when names one tests/ file: the entry is stored with that path among its write paths. One section's done-when names two tests/ files, and one names none: both entries are refused, each naming "the new test" and its sentence, while the other entries are stored. One section's sentence ends "and its regression test" and its done-when names one tests/ file: that entry is stored with the path too, so the rule holds for any description, not one phrase. One section names its test path in the sentence: its stored paths equal the base revision's. The negative control is the base revision, where the first entry is stored without the test path. The test files importing the changed modules add no failure against the base revision, run on all_debug one arm at a time with at most -n 4 . Every log is under the run directory, starts with its revision and the literal command, and ends in EXIT= . Ruff check and ruff format --check add no findings on the staged paths. Write paths: reckon/crew/dispatch_batch.py and tests/test_a_batch_entry_carries_its_done_when_test.py .
node_definition.goal: make a batch entry carry the test path its done-when names when its write-paths sentence names that file only by description
